introduction: Mississippi unemployment insurance provides temporary payments to eligible unemployed workers. MDES determines eligibility and processes weekly certifications.
description: Mississippi unemployment insurance provides temporary payments to eligible unemployed workers. MDES determines eligibility and processes weekly certifications.

sections.who: Work history, separation and ongoing availability requirements affect the claim. Follow MDES’s current work-search instructions.
sections.get: A claim calculation and eligibility review determine payable benefits. Payments are not automatic after registration.
sections.docs:
• Recent employer and separation information.
  • Identity and contact information.
  • Weekly work, earnings and search records.
sections.apply:
1. Start through MDES

    Use Unemployment Claims and its current online claim link.

  2. Complete the claim

    Answer accurately and read determinations.

  3. Certify weekly

    Submit each weekly certification and required work-search details.
sections.after: Keep records and respond to notices. For filing help call 601-493-9427.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using MDES claims; Work-search reporting. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
